name: app.pridepilot/pride-pilot
title: Pride Pilot
description: Gay and LGBTQ+ travel safety, laws, Pride events, bars and welcoming hotels for 227 countries.

tools.name: check_destination_safety
tools.description: Is it safe to travel there as a gay, lesbian, bi, trans or queer person? Dated, sourced LGBTQ+ travel conditions for 227 countries and territories and 18 LGBTQ+ hub cities, broken into separate dimensions: legal protections (whether same-sex relationships are legal, marriage recognition, anti-discrimination laws), public acceptance and showing affection in public (holding hands, kissing), trans and nonbinary ID, passports, entry and bathrooms, official UK and US travel advisories and recent changes, help on the ground (LGBTQ+ helplines, emergency numbers), and entry and health. Add trip dates to get Pride and events during the trip and what to confirm before going, or since to get what changed. Call it without a destination to list covered places.

traveler_type.description: Optional: who is traveling (same_sex_couple, trans_nonbinary, family_with_kids, solo or event_traveler). Only pass it when the user has said it.

since.description: Optional: show changes since this date, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: find_lgbtq_events
tools.description: Use for Pride calendars and LGBTQ+ event questions. Find Pride parades and festivals, gay and lesbian parties, circuit and dance events, bear weeks, drag and queer arts and culture festivals, LGBTQ+ sports weeks, gay and lesbian cruises, and community events in a destination between two dates (defaults to the next 120 days). Only dates confirmed by an organizer, tourism board or ticket listing are included. Leave out destination to get the calendar across every covered destination.

destination.description: Optional destination; leave out for all destinations

event_type.description: Optional: pride, festival, party, cruise, film, music or sports

tools.name: find_welcoming_stays
tools.description: Find gay-friendly and LGBTQ+ welcoming hotels and places to stay anywhere for the traveler's dates. 'vetted' holds stays Pride Pilot has checked (LGBTQ+ owned, LGBTQ+ focused or verified welcoming, with how each was vetted). 'general' holds hotel searches on Expedia, Hotels.com and Orbitz with the booking site's own LGBTQ+ welcoming filter on: those hotels are not checked by Pride Pilot. Pass traveler_country for Canadian or UK travelers.

traveler_country.description: Optional: where the traveler lives, e.g. 'Canada' or 'UK'

traveler_type.description: Optional: who is traveling (same_sex_couple, trans_nonbinary, family_with_kids, solo or event_traveler). Only pass it when the user has said it.

tools.name: find_lgbtq_tours
tools.description: Find tours, activities and things to do anywhere, e.g. a queer history walk in Berlin, a drag brunch, a gay nightlife tour in Madrid or a snorkel trip in Puerto Vallarta. 'vetted' holds queer-led or LGBTQ+ focused tours Pride Pilot has checked. 'general' holds bookable Viator tours that Pride Pilot has not reviewed for inclusivity. Where a destination has a safety warning for the traveler, the Viator search leans to private tours.

traveler_type.description: Optional: who is traveling (same_sex_couple, trans_nonbinary, family_with_kids, solo or event_traveler). Only pass it when the user has said it.

tools.name: find_lgbtq_places
tools.description: Find gay bars, lesbian bars, queer clubs and dance parties, drag venues, cafes, restaurants, gay beaches, gay saunas, gay neighborhoods (gayborhoods), LGBTQ+ community centers, sexual health clinics and shops that Pride Pilot has verified as LGBTQ+ owned, LGBTQ+ focused or verified welcoming, each with how it was vetted. Bars and clubs are separate kinds. Only verified places are ever returned. Places can carry tags such as women_only, women_focused, men_only and seasonal.

kind.description: Optional type of place: bar for bars, club for dance clubs and parties, sauna for gay saunas

tag.description: Optional: women_only, women_focused, men_only or seasonal
